description: Preferred and fallback source authorities for v4 corpus provenance. Preferred authorities should be used for core and validation corpus records whenever available.

source_authorities.name: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, University of Michigan Digital Edition
source_authorities.citation_format: Collected Works of Abraham Lincoln, volume and page range, University of Michigan Digital Edition.
source_authorities.notes: Primary preferred source for the current v1 corpus and v4 core carry-forward records.

source_authorities.name: Abraham Lincoln Papers at the Library of Congress
source_authorities.citation_format: Abraham Lincoln Papers, Library of Congress, item title, date, and collection identifier.
source_authorities.notes: Preferred authority for manuscript provenance, disputed variants, and item-level archival confirmation when available.

source_authorities.name: National Archives
source_authorities.citation_format: National Archives, record group or exhibit title, item title, date, and URL.
source_authorities.notes: Acceptable authority for official documents and federal records where a more specific scholarly edition is not available.

source_authorities.name: Miller Center Presidential Speeches
source_authorities.citation_format: Miller Center Presidential Speeches, speech title, date, and URL.
source_authorities.notes: Supplemental public-facing transcription source; should not replace scholarly edition or archival provenance for core claims.

source_authorities.name: Teaching American History
source_authorities.citation_format: Teaching American History, document title, date, and URL.
source_authorities.notes: Useful for discovery and classroom-facing access, but core and validation records require preferred or acceptable authority confirmation.

source_authorities.name: Uncurated public-domain transcription site
source_authorities.citation_format: Site name, page title, date accessed, and URL.
source_authorities.notes: Use only for reference-corpus discovery or when no stronger source is available; mark all such records with text-integrity cautions.

source_authorities.name: Project Gutenberg, The Papers and Writings of Abraham Lincoln, Complete
source_authorities.citation_format: Project Gutenberg eBook 3253, The Papers and Writings of Abraham Lincoln, Complete, edited by Arthur Brooks Lapsley, URL, and retrieval date.
source_authorities.notes: Public-domain access transcription used for raw-text ingestion when Michigan item pages are not script-accessible; retain scholarly edition citations in inventory metadata.

source_authorities.name: Abraham Lincoln Online Speeches and Writings
source_authorities.citation_format: Abraham Lincoln Online, document page title, URL, and retrieval date.
source_authorities.notes: Public-domain Lincoln text pages used for short writings where page text cites the Collected Works source and excludes site introductions during ingestion.

source_authorities.name: The Papers of Abraham Lincoln Digital Library
source_authorities.citation_format: The Papers of Abraham Lincoln Digital Library, document title, date, identifier, URL, and retrieval date.
source_authorities.notes: Preferred documentary editing project for item-level transcriptions and Basler publication cross-checks when available.
